feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 8 October 2026 4:35pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 08 October 2026 at 4:35pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure from the Azores to France. Low pressure near Iceland, with a frontal zone affecting the British Isles.


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5 backing south or southwest 6 through the evening, occasionally 7 in places, veering southwest 5 or 6 overnight, soon veering west tomorrow morning, increasing mainly 6 by late afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming mainly moderate this evening, then perhaps occasionally rough in places in the east of the area.


##Weather##

Periods of rain this evening and tonight, heavy at times, clearing to showers.


##Visibility##

Good, becoming mostly moderate in the rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 6 or 7, veering west-northwest later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, occasionally rough in places.


##Weather##

Showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
